name: Text to Image
description: Text to Image is an overview page: browse 27 image models and example prompts, then open Image Studio with your pick filled in.
shortDescription: Pick an image model or example prompt, then create it in Image Studio.
fullDescription: Text to Image (#/text-to-image) is a starting page, not a generator. It has a 'Start Creating Free' banner button, four 'Why Choose Our Text to Image?' highlight cards, an 'Available Models' grid of 27 model cards, five 'Example Prompts' cards with 'Try this →', and a 'Ready to Create?' section with 'Get Started Free' and '🎯 GTM Boost'. There is no prompt box, upload, aspect ratio or Generate button here: every button and card opens Image Studio (#/image). Clicking a model card opens Image Studio with that model selected when Image Studio has a text-to-image model with the same name; clicking an example prompt also puts the prompt text into Image Studio's prompt box. You then set the ratio and click Generate in Image Studio.
bestFor: New users who want to see which image models exist and start from a ready-made example prompt before opening Image Studio.
whenToUse: You want to browse image models by name and family before you start.
You want a ready-made example prompt filled into Image Studio for you.
You want help writing a marketing-style image prompt with GTM Boost.
whenToUseAnother: Use Image Studio (#/image) directly when you already know what to write: that is where prompt, model, ratio and Generate are.
Use Image to Image (#/image-to-image) or Edit Studio (#/edit) when you want to change a photo you already have.
Use Text to Video (#/text-to-video) or Video Studio (#/video) when you want a moving clip instead of a still image.
keyFeatures: 'Start Creating Free' and 'Get Started Free' buttons that open Image Studio.
'Why Choose Our Text to Image?' highlight cards (information only).
'Available Models' grid of 27 model cards; a click opens Image Studio with that model selected when the name matches.
'Example Prompts' with 'Try this →' that fill Image Studio's prompt box and model.
'🎯 GTM Boost' prompt helper whose result is sent to Image Studio's prompt box.

featureExplanations.explanation: The 'Start Creating Free' button on the 'Text to Image' banner opens Image Studio (#/image).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Quickest way from this page to the actual image generator.
featureExplanations.restrictions: It only opens Image Studio; nothing is generated here.

featureExplanations.feature: Why Choose Our Text to Image? cards
featureExplanations.explanation: Four information cards: 'Lightning Fast', '50+ Models', 'Multiple Ratios' and 'High Resolution' ('Generate images up to 4K resolution'). They are not buttons.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: A quick summary of what Image Studio offers.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Marketing text: the page itself lists 27 models while the card says '50+ Models'; Image Studio holds 84 text-to-image models. Available ratios and resolutions depend on the model you pick in Image Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: A grid of 27 model cards ('Choose from 27+ powerful image generation models'), each with a name, a family badge (Flux, Nano, Seedream, Midjourney, OpenAI, Ideogram, Google, SD, Wan, Hunyuan, Kling, Qwen) and a one-line description. Clicking a card opens Image Studio and pre-selects that model if Image Studio has a text-to-image model with the same name.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Start Image Studio on a specific model without searching its picker.
featureExplanations.restrictions: These names have no exact match in Image Studio, so it opens on your last-used (or default Nano Banana) model instead: Bytedance Seedream v3, GPT-4o, Ideogram v3, SDXL, Wan 2.1, Wan 2.5, Wan 2.6, Kling O1, Sora and Veo 3. Check the model button in Image Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: Five example cards, each with a model badge and a 'Try this →' button. Clicking the card or 'Try this →' opens Image Studio with the prompt text in the prompt box and the badge's model selected (when the name matches).
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Start from a proven prompt and edit it instead of writing from scratch.
featureExplanations.restrictions: The SDXL example's model name has no match in Image Studio, so only its prompt is carried over. You still click Generate in Image Studio.

featureExplanations.explanation: In the 'Ready to Create?' section, 'Get Started Free' opens Image Studio (#/image), the same as 'Start Creating Free'.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Open the generator after reading the page.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Nothing is generated on this page.

featureExplanations.explanation: The '🎯 GTM Boost' button opens the GTM Boost window ('🎯 GTM Boost · Text to Image'). You write your idea, pick an angle, audience and goal, and click the Boost button to get a conversion-focused prompt. 'Apply' closes the window and opens Image Studio with that prompt already in the prompt box.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Turn a rough marketing idea into a ready-to-use prompt before you start.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: An idea in step 1 (otherwise the window says 'Add your ... idea first.').
featureExplanations.restrictions: Without an OpenAI key the window shows 'Add your OpenAI key for AI-written results. Until then GTM Boost uses a built-in template.'

howToUse: 1. Open Text to Image (#/text-to-image). 2. Browse the 'Available Models' grid and click a model, or click an 'Example Prompts' card / 'Try this →'. Or click 'Start Creating Free' / 'Get Started Free' to open Image Studio with no presets. 3. Image Studio opens; check the model button and prompt box. 4. Write or edit the prompt, choose the aspect ratio, and click Generate in Image Studio.
howToSteps: Click a model card, an example prompt, or 'Start Creating Free'.
In Image Studio, check the selected model and the prompt.
Set aspect ratio and other options in Image Studio.
gettingStarted: Click the first example ('A futuristic cityscape at sunset...', Flux Dev) to see a filled-in Image Studio.
Change one or two words in the prompt and click Generate in Image Studio.
Come back here to try another model card.
requiredInputs: None on this page (it only opens Image Studio).

modeExplanations.description: Every control opens Image Studio, optionally with a model and/or prompt filled in.
modeExplanations.useCase: Pick a starting point, then generate in Image Studio.

modelCapabilities: The page lists 27 model names: Flux Dev, Flux Schnell, Flux 2 Dev/Flex/Pro, Nano Banana, Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2, Seedream 5.0, Bytedance Seedream v3/v4/v4.5, Midjourney v7, GPT-4o, GPT Image 1.5, Ideogram v3, Google Imagen4, SDXL, Wan 2.1/2.5/2.6, Hunyuan Image 2.1/3.0, Kling O1, Qwen Image, Sora and Veo 3. 17 of these match a model in Image Studio's text-to-image list (84 models); the rest open Image Studio on its usual model.
outputs: No output on this page; it opens Image Studio, optionally with a model and prompt filled in.
limitations: No prompt box, upload, ratio or Generate button on this page.
10 of the 27 model cards do not match an Image Studio model, so Image Studio keeps its own model.
Highlight cards ('50+ Models', 'up to 4K') are general marketing text, not settings.

limitationDetails.limitation: Some model cards are not pre-selected
limitationDetails.impact: Image Studio opens on your last-used or default model.
limitationDetails.workaround: Pick the model again with Image Studio's model button.

limitationDetails.impact: Clicking a card does not create an image.
limitationDetails.workaround: Click Generate in Image Studio after it opens.

troubleshooting: Image Studio opened on a different model than the card I clicked: that card's name has no exact match in Image Studio; choose the model with Image Studio's model button.
The example prompt did not appear: make sure you clicked the card or 'Try this →', not the Get Started button.

steps: Look at the model button in Image Studio.

faqs.question: Can I generate directly on this page?
faqs.answer: No. This page has no prompt box, upload, ratio or Generate button. Every button and card opens Image Studio (#/image), where the actual generation happens.

faqs.question: Why does the page say 27 models but a card says 50+?
faqs.answer: The '50+ Models' card is general marketing text. The page grid shows 27 names; Image Studio itself has 84 text-to-image models.

glossary.Prompt: The text you write to tell the AI what to make.
glossary.Model: The AI engine that makes the result; each one has its own style and options.
glossary.Prefill: When this page passes a prompt or model to the studio so it is already filled in when the studio opens.
glossary.GTM Boost: A helper window that rewrites your idea as a marketing-focused prompt (GTM = go-to-market).

tips: Use an example prompt as a template and change the subject.
Check Image Studio's model button after clicking a model card.
bestPractices: Treat this page as a menu; do your settings and generation in Image Studio.
